question: In the graph of Stopping Potential ($V_0$) versus Frequency ($\nu$), the straight line can be extrapolated backwards to intersect the negative potential axis (y-axis). What is the physical significance of the magnitude of this y-intercept?

options.A: It represents the threshold frequency in volts
options.B: It represents the Work Function of the metal measured in electron-volts (eV)
options.C: It represents the ratio of Planck's constant to charge
options.D: It represents the Work Function of the metal measured in Volts ($\phi_0/e$)
